scope: Nine returned images and all nine recorded attempts: South Africa 4, Saudi Arabia 4, USSR/Russia 1. Read-only country-return audit; only this receipt is written.
disposition: All nine are intact render returns. Eight have no blocking visual discrepancy in this bounded comparison. Gorbachev requires explicit Claude likeness review of the narrowed birthmark before registration. No image is registered or represented as human approved by this receipt.
method: Read the active requests and integrated identity reviews; compared exact active output sets, excluding the unprepared conditional Ryzhkov reserve.
SHA-256 over raw LF prompt bytes equals each return pin, integrated preparation pin, exact authored source-commit Git blob and integrated HEAD Git blob.

Checked two recorded inputs in order: approved Thatcher style anchor first, exact person's retained likeness reference second. Verified paths, hashes, byte counts, dimensions, modes and formats. No source-image conversion was recorded or detected.
Compared each repository reference with its retained external original and checked all recursively pinned external records under the nine used likeness references.
Compared every planned output byte-for-byte by SHA-256 and size against the retained generated original, and inspected with Pillow: all nine are RGB PNG at 1024×1536, with no alpha channel.

Personally viewed all nine selected outputs against all nine identity references and read all nine exact prompts. Compared subject selection, salient facial features, clothing, framing, visible hands/shoes, background and forbidden text/extra people.

Read the retained Commons metadata for source credits/licenses; preserved the earlier preflight findings on group-photo identities, original publication dates, derivative obligations and Gorbachev's month-only date.
Recorded authored and integrated Git document hashes separately from Windows CRLF working bytes; requests normalize exactly to their integrated LF Git blobs.
audit_scope_correction: An initial audit count included Ryzhkov's placeholder prompt object despite status 'not written'. A follow-up exact active-set comparison required an actual prompt SHA-256 and confirmed 4+4+1 active jobs. This was an audit-script scope correction, not a missing render.
limits: Return metadata records exact prompt submission and input order. This audit checks those declarations against retained files and requests; it does not independently replay the tool transport.
Approval remains false in all three country returns. This bounded audit is not Claude's registration review, historical-holder acceptance, new tenure evidence or whole-country completion.
Appearance windows and age extrapolations are art-use proposals only. Existing office observations, registry terms and unresolved research are not changed.

Excluded, superseded, reserve and deferred jobs remain ungenerated; no new asset search or generation was performed.
